name: YourApp
subtitle: What it does, in 30 characters
promotional: The problem in the customer's own words. What YourApp does about it, in one more sentence.
description: YourApp is not (the thing people expect). It is (the thing it is), said in two or three sentences.
A paragraph about how it works and why that is unlike the others.
• One feature. What the person does with it.
• One thing it leaves out on purpose.
A paragraph that names the people, never a promise to fix them.
The last line: what YourApp is not, and the one thing it takes off the person's hands.
